notes: Stadium Night: a complete visual pass built for glow and depth. Dark glass panels with blur and soft shadows over a deep background lit by your team color, glowing score bug, Sim button and progress bars, a lit-up versus panel with both teams' colors, a glowing active tab, smooth entrance motion when you change tabs, hover and press feedback on every control, and a Theme setting (Stadium night, Daylight, Match device). The PC app now checks for updates by itself on launch. Also in this build: online leagues (create or join with a six-letter code, everyone readies up, the week advances when all are in) and pass-and-play on one device, both from the start screen and the Program tab.
